app: In the Zoom web portal go to Admin > Advanced > Single Sign-On (a vanity URL https://{sub}.zoom.us must be approved first), then Configure SSO Manually (check your app's current UI).
Sign-in page URL = {idp_sso_url}; sign-out page URL = {idp_slo_url} if offered.
Identity provider certificate: paste the certificate body from {idp_cert_url} (without the BEGIN/END lines).
Issuer (IDP Entity ID) = {idp_entity_id}; Service Provider (SP) Entity ID = https://{sub}.zoom.us.
Binding can stay default (http-post or http-redirect - FlareID answers both); set the signature hash algorithm to SHA-256 and turn 'Sign SAML request' off.
Save, then under Security > Sign-in methods allow Single Sign-On and test with a non-admin user.
flareid: Add a SAML service provider (Admin > Applications > SAML service providers > New) and apply this template.
Replace {sub} with the approved vanity subdomain in both the entity ID and ACS URL.
Keep NameID format emailAddress - Zoom matches the assertion to a Zoom account strictly by email address.
The optional first_name/last_name/email attributes feed Zoom's SAML response mapping; adjust the names to what your Zoom mapping page expects (check your app's current UI).
